text.body:
[\C250\recto1'-3'] svayam api samayakṣatāv īdṛśam evābhiṣekaṃ yathācāryapraveśavidhau grahaṇam uktaṃ tathā gṛhnīyāt | kiṃ tu yadi sadgurur atidūre durgamārgādyupadravair agamyapradeśe prativasati nānyathā ||
sadā samādānatas tu prajñopāyaikarasasveṣṭadevatāyogena bhāvitamanomayamaṇḍale maṇḍaleśād udakābhiṣekādikaṃ guhyaprajñājñānacaturthaparyantam āśvāsasamayaparyantaṃ ca gṛhnīyād iti svasyābhiṣekavidhiḥ || ||

rtag tu yi dam byed pa ni shes rab dang thabs ro gcig par rang gi 'dod pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor gyi yid kyis rang bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor bsgoms nas dkyil 'khor gyi dbang phyug las {207b6} chu'i dbang la sogs pa dang gsang ba dang shes rab ye shes dang bzhi pa'i mthar thug pa rnams dang dbugs dbyung ba'i mthar thug pa blang bar bya'o zhes pa rang dbang
bskur ba'i cho ga'o || ||
